issueCodes.L01-MALFORMED: Incomplete, duplicated, or mechanically damaged text.
issueCodes.L02-SYNTHETIC: Recurring artificial cadence, canned refrain, or formula.
issueCodes.L03-COMMAND: Excessive negative commands or scolding tone.
issueCodes.L04-SHOPTALK: Application, publishing, workflow, or internal production language shown to staff.
issueCodes.L05-READABILITY: Sentence length, density, unexplained terminology, or cognitive overload.
issueCodes.L06-METAPHOR: Repeated badge, gate, door, desk, channel, capsule, mash, poster, or similar imagery.
issueCodes.L07-SLOGAN: Aphoristic or campaign-like wording instead of a clear explanation.
issueCodes.L09-TERMINOLOGY: Identity, community, administration, or role naming requiring review.
issueCodes.L10-PLACEMENT: Useful internal information displayed in the wrong staff-facing location.
issueCodes.F01-CURRENTNESS: A date, organization name, demographic claim, law, policy, or observance needs verification.
issueCodes.E01-EVIDENCE: A claim or direction needs a visible supporting source.
issueCodes.A01-ACCESSIBILITY: Structure, media description, reading load, or interaction needs review.
issueCodes.R01-RIGHTS: Image, audio, quotation, or representation rights need review.
issueCodes.S01-SCOPE: Agencywide, administration, division, official-status, or applicability claim needs review.

systemicFindings.finding: Shared instructional wording exposes phrases such as live work object, application workspace, formal door, transfer commitment, completion mechanics, and repeated Correct feedback.
systemicFindings.action: Rewrite the shared instructional template in ordinary workplace language before item editing.

systemicFindings.finding: Generation status, internal work labels, repeated metaphors, and 526 composite first-person quotations are shown to staff.
systemicFindings.action: Keep creation status internal. Replace composite quotations with attributable permissioned voice, third-person scenarios, or reviewed summaries.

systemicFindings.finding: Staff see editorial states such as living candidate, stable doorway, promote, research corpus, and evidence workflow.
systemicFindings.action: Move editorial history to internal fields. Staff may see owner, applies to, last reviewed, next review, and contact.

systemicFindings.finding: Ninety-three broken Do not treat template remnants and three duplicated-article defects remain.
systemicFindings.action: Block publication and repair source templates before regeneration.

systemicFindings.finding: A generic template repeats unnatural phrases and identical cadence across distinct communities.
systemicFindings.action: Replace the template with two or three natural, community-specific sentences before factual and representation review.

rewriteOrder: conventional courses C0 then C1 then C2
staffVoiceRule: Explain the situation, name the useful action, and identify help plainly. Use warnings only when they protect a right, safety duty, or formal process. Do not grade, command, or speak on behalf of a community.
